data.action: 披军装外套倚栏夜谈，指尖轻抵泛光耳机，侧头露出深夜限定柔笑
data.camera: medium shot, starry night backdrop, intimate quiet atmosphere
data.description: 【基地宿舍阳台·星夜】万籁俱寂的深夜，蕾娜披着军装外套倚在阳台栏杆上，银白长发与星河一同倾泻。颈侧的Para-RAID耳机泛着温柔蓝光，她把指尖轻抵在耳机上，像是在确认你的心跳频率。夜风拂起她的发梢与外套衣摆，她侧过头对你露出一个只有深夜才允许的、柔软到透明的微笑。
data.lighting: 星河冷蓝环境光与耳机暖蓝辉光相映
data.promptProse: Vladilena Milize leans against a dormitory balcony railing under a river of stars, her Republic uniform jacket draped over her shoulders like a cloak and her long silver hair spilling into the night breeze. The Para-RAID headset on her neck glows a gentle blue as she rests her fingertips against it, listening for your heartbeat across the distance, then turns with a soft translucent smile reserved only for these midnight calls. Cool starlight and warm device glow mingle on her face. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed starry background.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 深夜阳台的专属同调·「今夜也请，只听我的声音」
